headline: SB police officer beaten to death in Savar
summary: Sub-Inspector Md. Altab Hossain was killed by a mob after attempting to stop the assault of an elderly man in Aminbazar.
details: Sub-Inspector (SI) Md. Altab Hossain, a member of the Special Branch (SB) of the police, was beaten to death in the Bordeshi area of Aminbazar, Savar.
The incident occurred on Saturday night when Altab Hossain and his 26-year-old son, Ariful Islam, attempted to intervene and stop the assault of an elderly man.
A group of 20 to 25 attackers used indigenous weapons to assault them, resulting in the death of the 60-year-old officer.
His son, Ariful Islam, was critically injured in the attack and is currently receiving treatment at a hospital.
Police have since arrested the alleged mastermind behind the killing as investigations continue into the incident.
caption:
A Special Branch police officer was beaten to death in Savar after trying to save an elderly man from a mob attack.

Sub-Inspector (SI) Md. Altab Hossain, a member of the Special Branch (SB) of the police, was beaten to death in the Bordeshi area of Aminbazar, Savar.

The incident occurred on Saturday night when Altab Hossain and his 26-year-old son, Ariful Islam, attempted to intervene and stop the assault of an elderly man.

A group of 20 to 25 attackers used indigenous weapons to assault them, resulting in the death of the 60-year-old officer.

His son, Ariful Islam, was critically injured in the attack and is currently receiving treatment at a hospital.

Police have since arrested the alleged mastermind behind the killing as investigations continue into the incident.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV, The Daily Star

headline_marked: Body of Bangladeshi [[killed in Israeli drone strike]] returns home to Satkhira
headline: Body of Bangladeshi killed in Israeli drone strike returns home to Satkhira
summary: Shuvo Das, who was killed in Lebanon nearly four months ago, has been returned to his family in Sripatipura village.
details: The body of Shuvo Das, a resident of Sripatipura village in Satkhira's Kalaroa, has returned home after being killed in an Israeli drone strike in Lebanon.
Shuvo was killed on May 11 this year in a conflict-prone area of southern Lebanon. His body reached his home on Sunday morning, 3 months and 25 days after the incident.
He had moved to Lebanon approximately two and a half years before his death. He was the second of three brothers and one sister.
According to Moin Uddin, a counselor at the Khulna divisional office of the Ministry of Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment, the government has provided a check for 85,000 BDT to the family.
The family is expected to receive an additional 3 lakh BDT this month and further grants from life insurance in the coming months.

Shuvo was one of three Bangladeshis from Satkhira killed in the Israeli drone strikes in Lebanon. The others were Nahidul from Ashashuni and Shafiqul Islam from Sadar's Bhaluka Chadpur, whose bodies had already been returned.
caption:
After nearly 4 months, the body of a Bangladeshi man killed in an Israeli drone strike in Lebanon has finally returned home.

The body of Shuvo Das, a resident of Sripatipura village in Satkhira's Kalaroa, has returned home after being killed in an Israeli drone strike in Lebanon.

Shuvo was killed on May 11 this year in a conflict-prone area of southern Lebanon. His body reached his home on Sunday morning, 3 months and 25 days after the incident.

He had moved to Lebanon approximately two and a half years before his death. He was the second of three brothers and one sister.

According to Moin Uddin, a counselor at the Khulna divisional office of the Ministry of Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment, the government has provided a check for 85,000 BDT to the family.

The family is expected to receive an additional 3 lakh BDT this month and further grants from life insurance in the coming months.

Shuvo was one of three Bangladeshis from Satkhira killed in the Israeli drone strikes in Lebanon. The others were Nahidul from Ashashuni and Shafiqul Islam from Sadar's Bhaluka Chadpur, whose bodies had already been returned.

#Bangladesh #Lebanon #Satkhira #News #International

Source: Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star
